metadata.description: A focus dashboard and a warm dark theme for Claude Code, built on one design system.

plugins.name: pomo
plugins.description: A pixel-art focus dashboard beside the chat: Cinder the ember shows what you're doing, a ring burns down segment by segment, plus a parking lot for stray thoughts, your day and week, noise, chimes and logging to your Obsidian daily note.

plugins.name: ember-theme
plugins.description: A warm, dark-only theme for long sessions: quiet warm-neutral surfaces, one ember-orange accent, and a faint ASCII field at the window's edges that follows the pomo timer. No blue anywhere.
